items.title: How soon the Clarity Act could pass — and what investors should know
items.summary: The US Senate is expected to hold a procedural vote on the Clarity Act on Tuesday, Sept. 15, which will require 60 votes to pass.  Coinbase (COIN) Chief Policy Officer Faryar Shirzad joins Market Domination host Brooke DiPalma to discuss the legislation focused on a regulatory framework on crypto, how many rounds of voting it will have to go through, and what would happen if the act doesn't pass.  Disclosure: Yahoo Finance has a partnership with Coinbase.

items.title: Bullish Stock Is Set to Win Whatever Happens to Crypto Law, Analyst Says

items.title: Should You Buy Coinbase Stock While Its Revenue Is Shrinking?
items.summary: Coinbase Global (COIN) stock has gained about 18% over the past month, and it is still down about 44% over the past year. At about $175 a share, the market pays 7.3 times sales against 3.2 for the S&P 500, more than double the market's price for revenue that is shrinking. The question is whether what Coinbase is building is worth more than what it is losing.

items.title: This One Stock Looks Bullish Amid Morgan Stanley's 30-Day Crash Warning
items.summary: Coinbase stock jumped 8% on a bearish analyst's upgrade, days after Morgan Stanley warned the market could crack in 30 days.

items.title: The Clarity Act Gains Momentum: What you Need to Know
items.summary: By establishing clear regulatory boundaries between federal oversight agencies, enforcing stronger consumer safeguards, and implementing ethics guidelines, the Clarity Act offers a path out of years of regulatory uncertainty.
